s02-spring.observed_description: The same large tree on the grassy hill, covered in pink and white blossom with a few light-green leaves; yellow and purple spring flowers grow in fresh green grass around the bench and the path. No people.
s02-spring.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). Same tree, hill, bench and path as the summer photo; only the season changed. The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing is written in the photo.

s03-fall.observed_description: The same large tree on the hill with all its leaves orange and red, leaves falling through the air and a carpet of fallen leaves over the grass around the bench, in low golden light. No people.
s03-fall.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). Same tree, hill, bench and path as the summer photo; only the season changed. The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing is written in the photo.

s04-winter.observed_description: The same large tree on the hill, bare and carrying snow on its branches; deep white snow covers the hill, the bench and the path under a pale gray sky. No people.
s04-winter.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). Same tree, hill, bench and path as the summer photo; only the season changed. The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing is written in the photo.
